product.title: Chicago Bike Tour

description.text: Explore Chicago's lakefront and downtown paths on a three-hour guided bike tour with stops at Millennium Park, Grant Park, and Navy Pier. Your guide leads a paced route along the Lakefront Trail with commentary on skyline landmarks and lakefront development. Bikes, helmets, and a safety briefing are included with routing matched to the group's ability. This active group tour covers more ground than a walking tour while keeping a social, guided format.

highlights: Guided three-hour Chicago lakefront bike tour
Millennium Park and Grant Park riding stops
Navy Pier and Lakefront Trail segments
Bikes, helmets, and safety briefing included

start.description: Meet at the bike rental staging area near Millennium Park confirmed when booking. Arrive 15 minutes early for fitting.

end.description: Return bikes to the staging area after the final lakefront stop.
